title: Correct causal histories make counterfactual latent prediction learnable, but catalogue-wide action selection remains unsolved
decision: Do not launch paper-scale ALFWorld training yet; first test whether broader exact observed-counterfactual coverage improves full-catalogue ranking and closed-loop control.
plain_summary: Direct counterfactual latent prediction reduces observed-alternative error by 60 to 68 percent relative to persistence, but all models still solve zero episodes because two alternatives per state do not constrain hundreds of catalogue actions.
